title: You
subtitle: Everything about you and your Otula in one place.
modeHint: When your period returns, we switch to cycle mode. Your history stays.
surveyHint: Something changed? We will learn again.
circleHint: Requests, link for loved ones, trusted person.
pushDisabledNote: Turn notifications on so reminders can reach you.
deleteBody: We will remove everything: check-ins, goals, questions and requests. This cannot be undone.
medicalNote: Otula is not a medical device and does not diagnose. If something worries you, talk to your midwife or doctor, or call emergency services.
